{{dablink|For the farmer near [[Watch Hill]], see [[Flann Barstere]]. For others with the same surname, see [[Lewin (disambiguation)|Lewin]].}}

'''Flann Lewin''' is a [[Two Rivers]] farmer.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Flann Lewin|Flann}} He is married to [[Adine Lewin]], and [[Tell Lewin|Tell]] and [[Dannil Lewin|Dannil]] are his nephews.{{ref||Flann}}

== Appearance ==
He is gnarled and gray-haired and as thin as a beanpole.

== Activities ==
He is present on the al'Seen farm when Perrin visits with Faile.{{ref/book|4|32}}

He helps defend [[Emond's Field]] against the invading [[Trolloc]] army.{{ref/book|4|56}}
